why_this_exists: Step 274 revived the valuation family by widening the book that originally failed a concentration gate. It is the first candidate in this project to pass a gate it previously failed, and the only one whose correlation against every existing strategy is near zero. Historical evidence is where every candidate here has died, so this goes on a clock rather than into the dashboard.
signal: earnings yield, ranked cross-sectionally, from the survivorship-aware valuation panel in evidence/sec_survivorship_valuation_discovery_v1/factor_scores.csv whose validation checks all passed
book: equal weight, breadth 20, the twenty highest earnings-yield issuers priced at the decision
rebalance: on each quarterly decision, executed the first weekly close strictly after it
decision_snapshot_window: observed at or after 21:00 UTC on the decision Friday and before 21:00 UTC the following Friday
missed_snapshot_policy: a missed weekly window cannot be backfilled from a later vintage
mutation_policy: any change to the signal, breadth, cost, cadence or universe creates a new protocol version and restarts its clock at zero

historical_record_stated_honestly.full_window: 32.56% CAGR, Sharpe 1.379, max drawdown -18.52% over 192 weeks at 50bps
historical_record_stated_honestly.before_2025_04_04: 23.61% CAGR at Sharpe 1.081, against the growth book's 8.15% at 0.497
historical_record_stated_honestly.excess_over_its_own_scored_universe: +14.5 points before the break and +10.7 points after
historical_record_stated_honestly.concentration: top issuer contributes 6.6% of positive contribution, against a 10% gate the original ten-name book failed
historical_record_stated_honestly.leave_one_out: 109 distinct issuers held; removing the most important one costs 2.01 points of 32.56%

selection_status: selected after observing the historical sample, and the search was large: sixteen configurations declared here on a panel the original discovery searched ninety ways. Forward evidence is mandatory and the historical record never advances this clock.
what_would_make_this_interesting: 52 untouched weeks with a positive mean excess over an equal weight of its own scored universe, and a correlation against the residual composite that stays below 0.3. The second condition matters more than the first: a modest independent return is worth more to this portfolio than a large correlated one.
what_would_refute_it: a forward record indistinguishable from its own universe, which would mean the excess was the sixteen-times-ninety search
runs_alongside: sec_residual_controlled_sleeve_forward_v1, equal_weight_benchmark_v1, sue_quarterly_forward_v1 and residual_tie_agnostic_companion_v1, and modifies none of them
